narrative.overview: The portfolio-wide soft-summer system remains the public identity and the default private-surface language. The separately approved /admin Editorial Index is a route-scoped working CMS: ivory paper, ink and quiet gray-green, deep-green actions, locally hosted Nunito Sans, hairline flat rows, and an aligned website-order index. It does not change the global Experience mode or the Firebase inbox.
keyCharacteristics: Pale blue, seafoam, butter and peach public fields.
Chunky identity lettering with rounded readable supporting type.
Route-scoped /admin Editorial Index with ivory/ink, green actions and hairline rows.

rules.name: The Readable Pastel Rule
rules.body: Pastels belong to surfaces, not low-contrast body text. Use dark teal or the muted text token on light fields.

rules.name: The Heading First Rule
rules.body: Section titles lead; supporting context follows below them, not as an eyebrow.

rules.name: The Flat Evidence Rule
rules.body: Use spacing, color and rules to organize evidence before adding raised cards.

rules.name: The Admin Route Boundary Rule
rules.body: The ivory/ink Editorial Index belongs only to /admin; the Firebase inbox remains summer.

dos: Do preserve all bilingual copy, factual metrics and external documentation links.
Do carry the summer palette across public surfaces and private surfaces by default; /admin is the approved Editorial Index exception, while the Firebase inbox remains summer.
Do use original engineering/data illustration rather than beach objects.
Do honor reduced motion, visible keyboard focus and clear labels.
donts: Don't reuse the watermarked reference as a shipping asset.
Don't return to navy/gold glass styling or corporate-report art direction.
Don't add fabricated project claims or decorative chart values.
Don't hide real content behind entrance effects.
